story.title: The Memory Tenant
story.logline: A woman discovers her landlord is charging her rent not in cash, but in her happiest childhood memories.
story.theme: The true cost of holding onto the past
story.twist: The landlord is actually her future self, trying to survive a desolate future by stealing joy.
story.ending: If I pay this month, who will I be tomorrow?

scenes.narration: My landlord doesn't want my money. He wants my very first birthday party, paid in full today.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, a 25-year-old woman with messy dark hair and a faded yellow sweater, inside a dim wooden hallway.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on Maya's terrified eyes, pushing in rapidly.

scenes.narration: Maya, a 25-year-old woman with messy dark hair and a faded yellow sweater, hands over the glowing orb of cake and laughter.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, dark messy hair, faded yellow sweater, standing in the dim wooden hallway, holding a glowing blue memory sphere.
scenes.camera: Medium shot tracking backward as she extends her trembling hands.

scenes.narration: The old man swallows the light. Instantly, my mind goes blank. The chocolate cake? Never existed.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, dark messy hair, faded yellow sweater, in the dim hallway, watching an elderly man swallow a glowing light.
scenes.camera: Over-the-shoulder shot focusing on the old man's greedy face.

scenes.narration: Rent is due every week. If the account is empty, you vanish from this world completely. No exceptions.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, dark messy hair, faded yellow sweater, staring at a massive ledger on a dark wooden desk.
scenes.camera: Low angle looking up at Maya as fear crosses her features.

scenes.narration: I search my brain for anything left. Summer rain, first kisses, my mother's warm embrace on cold nights.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, dark messy hair, faded yellow sweater, sitting on a bare mattress in a sterile room, clutching her head.
scenes.camera: Close-up on her face, shallow depth of field.

scenes.narration: He knocks again. Next month's price is steep. He demands the day I learned how to ride a bike.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, dark messy hair, faded yellow sweater, looking toward a heavy oak apartment door as fist knocks.
scenes.camera: Static medium shot, watching the door rattle violently.

scenes.narration: I refuse to give it up. I pull back his sleeve to see why he needs my joy so badly.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, dark messy hair, faded yellow sweater, grabbing the old man's wrinkled wrist in the dim hallway.
scenes.camera: Close-up on the gripping hands, dramatic side lighting.

scenes.narration: There is a scar on his arm. The exact same jagged scar I received when I fell at age ten.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, dark messy hair, faded yellow sweater, staring in horror at a jagged scar on the old man's bare forearm.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on the matching scar.

scenes.narration: He looks at me with hollow, weeping eyes. He whispers that this is the only way we survive.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, dark messy hair, faded yellow sweater, facing an older version of herself in the mirror-like hallway light.
scenes.camera: Two-shot reflecting both faces in a cracked mirror.

scenes.narration: If I pay this month's rent with my past, who will I be tomorrow?
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, dark messy hair, faded yellow sweater, standing alone in a completely white, empty void.
scenes.camera: Wide cinematic shot, slowly zooming out into total darkness.

caption.hook: Rent is due. Pay with a memory.
caption.title: The Memory Tenant
caption.caption: She thought her landlord was just eccentric. Until she realized the apartment was eating her childhood, one happy moment at a time. What would you pay to keep a roof over your head?
